title: Canva for farmers and agribusinesses
why: Buyers trust farms that look organised. Simple price lists, produce posters and harvest updates help you sell directly at better prices.
what_is_different: Farm marketing is seasonal and local: harvest announcements, price lists by weight, delivery days and pickup locations, shared on WhatsApp and Facebook.

extra_modules.title: Harvest and price list posts
extra_modules.outcome: You can: announce produce, prices and delivery days
extra_modules.practice: Create a harvest announcement with prices

starter_project: Create a season's marketing set: farm logo, price list template, harvest announcement and a short farm video for WhatsApp.

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
